diagnosis.overall_diagnosis: The pipeline succeeds end-to-end but fails precision: of 12 detected segments only 6 match ground truth (IoU>0.3). Recall passes, so the issue is over-detection of short false-positive pauses. The pause-detector is producing too many short 2-3s segments that don't correspond to real pauses, likely because threshold_ratio=0.5 is too permissive and min_duration=2 catches too many borderline cases. Tightening pause-detector defaults (stricter threshold, slightly longer min_duration, or merging nearby segments) would improve precision. The silence-detector opening segment (0-221) is correct. Segment-combiner could also help by merging adjacent segments (e.g., 522-524 and 525-527).

diagnosed_skills.diagnosis: Default parameters produce too many false-positive pauses, yielding 50% precision. The threshold_ratio=0.5 is too permissive and min_duration=2 captures borderline low-energy moments that are not true pauses. Several detected pauses (228-231, 232-237, 239-241, 525-527, 557-559, 597-599) do not match ground truth.
diagnosed_skills.repair_instruction: Update pause-detector/SKILL.md to recommend stricter default parameters for teaching-video pause detection to improve precision: lower threshold_ratio (e.g., 0.3-0.4 instead of 0.5), slightly larger min_duration (e.g., 2.5-3s), and a merge step for adjacent/nearby detected segments (gap < 2s). Document a 'high-precision preset' in the Usage section and in Notes explain the precision/recall tradeoff. Also recommend post-filtering: discard segments whose energy is close to the local average (within 10%) and merge consecutive segments separated by <2 seconds into one segment before output.

diagnosed_skills.diagnosis: The combiner currently only concatenates and sorts segments without merging adjacent/overlapping ones. Pairs like (522-524) and (525-527) could be merged into one segment, which would both reduce false-positive count and better match ground truth IoU.
diagnosed_skills.repair_instruction: Update segment-combiner/SKILL.md to document and recommend merging adjacent segments whose gap is below a small threshold (e.g., 2 seconds) into a single segment. Add a '--merge-gap' parameter description (default 2s) and note that merging improves precision for downstream evaluation. Include an example showing two near-adjacent pauses being merged into one.
